title: Kadıköy Sevgilim
author: Ahmet Erol
description: Anyone who has nurtured love within knows that every kind of love exists with its trials and tribulations, its joy and its sorrow. The heart carries everything—until one day it grows weary, seized by the urgency to save itself, to keep beating. And in that moment, it is time to leave the one you love exactly where they stand, and walk away without looking back. Kadıköy Sevgilim is the story of an unplanned life journey that begins in Fikirtepe during the darkest days of Türkiye’s political history.
